description: Fresh-score ONE account (a single platform handle). This is a BUILDING BLOCK, not the product: a CreatorScore is ALWAYS a creator's full cross-platform FOOTPRINT, never a single-platform number. To score a creator, use score_creator_footprint — NEVER offer 'score just this one platform' as an alternative to the footprint. Use this tool only to COMPLETE a footprint: fill an account that score_creator_footprint reported as not-yet-scored, or REFRESH one account flagged STALE by find_creator / vet_creator. It scrapes the account's latest content, transcribes videos, and runs the v2.2 seven-agent model (queued — poll with check_score_job). COSTS 1 credit per account and triggers live scraping; do NOT loop across a roster without per-account user confirmation. Requires confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually spend credits. If false/omitted, the tool explains the cost and does nothing.

include.description: Optional extra fields once the score is ready.

name: score_creator_fresh
